$comment: Permanent team members bundled with the plugin beyond the 12 core roles. Each entry is enforced by the guard in every project: write = globs this member owns (carved out of the developer's area, checked after .team/, docs, infra and tests), bash = none | readonly | developer | db-local, hookPoints/trigger tell the lead when to call it. A project can add globs for a member in .claude/technical-team.json -> paths.<member>. In the technical-team plugin repo itself, hr adds members here after an approved hire.

dba.trigger: the change touches schema, migrations, seeds, existing data, or queries on large tables
